description: Golden dataset for the support-email classifier. Drafted by AI (Claude) as review candidates, then reviewed case by case by Ihsan Duru on 2026-09-09 (labels/summaries corrected where needed; see verification fields). Includes deliberate edge cases: ambiguous/mixed, extremely short, typos, mixed languages, sarcasm, angry.

cases.input: Hello, I was charged $49 on the 3rd and again on the 5th for the same Pro plan. Invoice numbers INV-20931 and INV-20977. Please refund the duplicate.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged twice for the Pro plan (invoices INV-20931 and INV-20977) and wants the duplicate refunded.

cases.input: Can you send me a proper VAT invoice for last month? My accountant needs our company VAT number on it: DE811223344.
cases.expected_summary: Customer needs last month's invoice reissued with their company VAT number DE811223344.

cases.input: Why did my monthly price go from 12 to 15 dollars? I didn't change anything.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks why their monthly price increased from $12 to $15 without any change on their side.

cases.input: I cancelled in June but you're still billing me. Stop it and refund July and August.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cancelled in June but was billed for July and August and wants the charges stopped and refunded.

cases.input: How do I switch from monthly to annual billing and is there a discount?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to know how to switch to annual billing and whether it is discounted.

cases.input: My card expired and the payment failed, now the app says 'read only'. I've added the new card, when will it retry?
cases.expected_summary: Customer's payment failed due to an expired card, added a new card, and asks when the retry will happen so read-only mode ends.
cases.notes: mentions app behaviour but the ask is about payment retry. I think there should be a way to notify the user for when the 'read only' will be changed for the user, if it is typical scenario it should notify the user.

cases.input: We have 14 seats on the invoice but only 9 people actually use it. Can we get a credit for the extra 5?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is invoiced for 14 seats but uses 9 and asks for a credit for the 5 unused seats.

cases.input: hi. receipt pls. thx
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for a receipt.

cases.input: I see a charge from you on my statement but I don't remember signing up. What is this for and how do I get my money back?
cases.expected_summary: Customer sees an unrecognised charge on their statement and wants to know what it is and how to get a refund.

cases.input: Our PO process requires net-60 terms and an invoice before payment; your checkout only takes cards. Is there an enterprise option?
cases.expected_summary: Customer needs net-60 invoicing instead of card checkout and asks about an enterprise billing option.

cases.input: Bonjour, j'ai été facturé deux fois ce mois-ci (le 2 et le 4). Merci de rembourser le doublon.
cases.expected_summary: Customer (in French) was charged twice this month, on the 2nd and 4th, and asks for the duplicate to be refunded.

cases.input: Great, so you 'upgraded' me automatically to the $99 tier without asking. Love that for me. Reverse it.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was automatically moved to the $99 tier without consent and wants it reversed.

cases.input: The invoice PDF from May won't download — the link gives a 404. I need it for expenses.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot download the May invoice PDF because the link returns a 404 and needs it for expenses.
cases.notes: technical symptom, but the customer needs the invoice; ambiguous with technical

cases.input: Do you offer student pricing? I have a .edu email.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether student pricing is available with a .edu email.
cases.notes: the student is not asking about billing they are asking about price for student accounts.

cases.input: We were promised 20% off for the first year by your sales rep (Dana) but the invoice is full price.
cases.expected_summary: Customer says a sales rep promised 20% off the first year but the invoice shows full price.

cases.input: Please update the billing email to finance@acme-corp.example so invoices stop going to my personal inbox.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants invoices sent to finance@acme-corp.example instead of their personal email.
cases.notes: billing contact change; could be read as account

cases.input: Is the free trial really free? Will I be charged if I forget to cancel?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether the free trial is free and if they will be charged if they forget to cancel.

cases.input: charged 3x today. 3 TIMES. card is now blocked by my bank because of you. fix this now
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged three times today, their bank blocked the card, and they demand an immediate fix and refund.

cases.input: Can I get a refund for the 3 weeks I couldn't use the product during the outage in August?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for a refund for the three weeks the product was unusable during the August outage.
cases.notes: mentions outage but asks for money back

cases.input: What payment methods do you accept? Only cards or also SEPA / bank transfer?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks which payment methods are accepted, specifically SEPA or bank transfer besides cards.

cases.input: The dashboard shows a blank white page after login since this morning. Chrome 129 on Mac. Console says 'TypeError: cannot read properties of undefined'.
cases.expected_summary: Dashboard is a blank page after login on Chrome 129/Mac with a TypeError in the console since this morning.

cases.input: Webhooks stopped arriving around 14:00 UTC yesterday. No changes on our side. Endpoint returns 200 when I test it manually.
cases.expected_summary: Webhooks stopped being delivered since 14:00 UTC yesterday although the customer's endpoint works.

cases.input: API returns 429 even though we're at ~40 req/min, well under the 100 limit on our plan.
cases.expected_summary: API returns 429 rate-limit errors at about 40 requests per minute, under the plan's 100 limit.

cases.input: The mobile app crashes on launch on Android 14 (Pixel 7) after the latest update.
cases.expected_summary: Mobile app crashes on launch on a Pixel 7 running Android 14 after the latest update.

cases.input: Exports of large projects (>10k rows) time out. Smaller ones work. Is there a limit or a workaround?
cases.expected_summary: Exports of projects over 10,000 rows time out and the customer asks about limits or a workaround.

cases.input: The Slack integration posts every message twice. Disconnected and reconnected, still duplicates.
cases.expected_summary: Slack integration posts every message twice even after reconnecting.

cases.input: Since v3.2 the search ignores accented characters — searching 'café' no longer finds 'café'. Regression?
cases.expected_summary: Since v3.2, search no longer matches accented characters such as 'café'.

cases.input: Error when i uplaod a csv: 'unexpected token at line 1'. file is utf-8 with BOM i think. worked before
cases.expected_summary: CSV upload fails with 'unexpected token at line 1', possibly due to a UTF-8 BOM; it worked before.

cases.input: Not urgent but your OAuth callback rejects redirect URIs with a port (localhost:3000). RFC 6749 allows this. Local dev is painful.
cases.expected_summary: OAuth callback rejects redirect URIs containing a port such as localhost:3000, blocking local development.

cases.input: Page load went from 1s to 8s this week. Network tab shows /api/v2/feed taking 6s. Nothing changed on our end.
cases.expected_summary: Page loads slowed from 1 s to 8 s this week because /api/v2/feed takes 6 s.

cases.input: Hola, la app no sincroniza desde ayer. Sale 'error de red' aunque tengo internet. ¿Qué hago?
cases.expected_summary: Customer (in Spanish) reports the app has not synced since yesterday and shows a network error despite having internet.

cases.input: 2FA codes from your app are rejected as 'expired' the moment I enter them. Phone clock is correct.
cases.expected_summary: 2FA codes are rejected as expired immediately even though the phone clock is correct.
cases.notes: 2FA sounds like account, but it is a malfunction of the code check

cases.input: Oh wonderful, another 'improvement' — the keyboard shortcut for save now opens the settings. Genius. Please put it back.
cases.expected_summary: After the latest update the save keyboard shortcut opens settings instead of saving; customer wants the old behaviour back.

cases.input: Getting 'certificate has expired' when calling api.yourservice.example from our servers since midnight.
cases.expected_summary: API calls to api.yourservice.example fail with a certificate-expired error since midnight.

cases.input: The PDF export cuts off the right side of wide tables. Landscape option doesn't help.
cases.expected_summary: PDF export truncates the right side of wide tables even in landscape mode.

cases.input: broken
cases.expected_summary: Customer says something is broken but gives no details.
cases.notes: extremely short; no actionable info — labelled technical because 'broken' implies malfunction; reviewer may prefer general

cases.input: Data in the reports view is off by one day compared to the raw export — looks like a timezone bug (we're UTC+10).
cases.expected_summary: Report dates are off by one day versus the raw export, likely a timezone bug for a UTC+10 customer.

cases.input: Images uploaded in the editor appear rotated 90 degrees. iPhone photos.
cases.expected_summary: Images uploaded from an iPhone appear rotated 90 degrees in the editor.

cases.input: Your Python SDK 2.4.0 raises ImportError on pydantic v2. Pinning 2.3.1 works. Please fix compatibility.
cases.expected_summary: Python SDK 2.4.0 fails with an ImportError on Pydantic v2 while 2.3.1 works; customer asks for a compatibility fix.

cases.input: Notifications arrive 30-40 minutes late. Push is enabled, battery optimisation is off. Android.
cases.expected_summary: Push notifications on Android arrive 30–40 minutes late despite correct settings.

cases.input: I can't log in. It says my password is wrong but I just reset it twice.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in even after resetting their password twice.

cases.input: Please change my account email from old@example.com to new@example.com. I no longer have access to the old one.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants their account email changed to new@example.com because they lost access to the old address.

cases.input: How do I turn on two-factor authentication for my whole team?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to enable two-factor authentication for their entire team.

cases.input: I want to delete my account and all my data. How do I do that?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to delete their account and all associated data.

cases.input: I lost my phone and my authenticator app with it. I'm locked out. Backup codes are on the laptop I can't log into.
cases.expected_summary: Customer lost their phone with the authenticator app and their backup codes are inaccessible, so they are locked out.

cases.input: A former employee (j.smith) still has admin access. Please remove them and make me the owner.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants a former employee's admin access removed and ownership transferred to themselves.

cases.input: We have two workspaces by mistake, acme and acme-inc. Can you merge them into one?
cases.expected_summary: Customer accidentally has two workspaces (acme and acme-inc) and wants them merged.

cases.input: login broken?? tried 5 times
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in after five attempts.

cases.input: The magic-link email never arrives. Checked spam. Other emails from you arrive fine. Only affects my colleague's address on our domain.
cases.expected_summary: Magic-link login emails do not arrive for one colleague's address although other emails from the company do.
cases.notes: delivery bug vs. account access; the ask is to regain access

cases.input: Ich habe mein Passwort vergessen und die Reset-Mail kommt nicht an. Bitte um Hilfe.
cases.expected_summary: Customer (in German) forgot their password and is not receiving the reset email.

cases.input: Cool, so after 'security improvements' I'm locked out of my own account for 24h because I logged in from my parents' house. Amazing. Unlock me.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was locked out for 24 hours after logging in from a new location and wants their account unlocked.

cases.input: Can I change my username? It's my old company name.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether they can change their username.

cases.input: I'm the new admin at Northwind. My predecessor set everything up with his personal email. How do we regain control of the org?
cases.expected_summary: New admin needs to regain control of an organisation set up under a former employee's personal email.

cases.input: Please downgrade my role from owner to member; Priya (priya@northwind.example) should be the new owner.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to hand ownership to Priya and become a regular member.

cases.input: Do you support SSO with Okta? We want to enforce it for all users.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether Okta SSO is supported and can be enforced for all users.

cases.input: I keep getting logged out every 10 minutes on the web app, on every device. Started Monday.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is logged out every 10 minutes on all devices since Monday.
cases.notes: session bug; could be technical — labelled account since it is about staying logged in

cases.input: Someone logged into my account from Brazil last night (I'm in Ireland). I've changed the password. What else should I do and can you see what they accessed?
cases.expected_summary: Customer saw an unauthorised login from Brazil, changed their password, and asks what else to do and what was accessed.

cases.input: How many users can I invite on the Team plan?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how many users can be invited on the Team plan.
cases.notes: plan limits; could be billing/general — reviewer decision

cases.input: My invite link says 'expired' but it was sent an hour ago.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's invite link shows as expired although it was sent an hour ago.

cases.input: Remove my phone number from the account, I never agreed to SMS.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants their phone number removed from the account and no SMS contact.

cases.input: Do you have a dark mode planned? Would love it.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether dark mode is planned.

cases.input: Hi! I run a newsletter about productivity tools. Would you be open to a partnership or affiliate deal?
cases.expected_summary: Newsletter author proposes a partnership or affiliate deal.

cases.input: Where is your company based and do you store data in the EU?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks where the company is based and whether data is stored in the EU.

cases.input: Just wanted to say the new editor is fantastic. No issues, keep it up!
cases.expected_summary: Customer sends positive feedback about the new editor; no action requested.

cases.input: Can you add an option to export to Notion? Right now I copy-paste everything.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a Notion export feature.

cases.input: Are you hiring support engineers? I'd like to apply.
cases.expected_summary: Person asks about support engineer job openings.

cases.input: Is your service GDPR compliant and do you have a DPA we can sign?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about GDPR compliance and a signable data processing agreement.
Customer sent an empty question mark with no content.

cases.input: We're a nonprofit in Kenya teaching coding to teenagers; would you consider sponsoring 50 licences?
cases.expected_summary: Nonprofit asks the company to sponsor 50 licences for a coding programme in Kenya.
cases.notes: mentions licences (billing-adjacent) but the ask is sponsorship

cases.input: Wow, a 40-minute onboarding video. Truly, who has the time. Any chance of a 2-page quick start?
cases.expected_summary: Customer finds the 40-minute onboarding video too long and asks for a short written quick-start guide.

cases.input: Ciao, avete una versione in italiano dell'interfaccia? Grazie.
cases.expected_summary: Customer (in Italian) asks whether the interface is available in Italian.

cases.input: Could you tell me the difference between the Team and Business plans? The pricing page is confusing.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for an explanation of the differences between the Team and Business plans.
cases.notes: pricing page question without a billing action; could be billing

cases.input: Unsubscribe me from marketing emails please.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to be unsubscribed from marketing emails.

cases.input: I'm writing a blog post comparing tools in your space. Can someone answer a few questions?
cases.expected_summary: Blogger asks for someone to answer questions for a comparison article.

cases.input: Does the app work offline?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether the app works offline.

cases.input: Your status page says all systems operational but Twitter is full of people saying it's down. Which is it?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether the service is down, since the status page and social media disagree.
cases.notes: possible incident, but no personal issue reported; reviewer may prefer technical

cases.input: This is the third time I'm writing. Nobody answers. Do you even have a support team?
cases.expected_summary: Customer complains that previous messages received no reply and asks whether support exists.

cases.input: Can we get a shared inbox feature so multiple agents can work on the same conversation?
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a shared inbox feature for multiple agents.

cases.input: What is your uptime SLA for the Business plan?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about the uptime SLA of the Business plan.

cases.input: I accidentally sent this to the wrong company, please ignore.
cases.expected_summary: Customer emailed the wrong company and asks for the message to be ignored.
